Who we are 

We simplify wealth creation. Founded in 2014 in Vienna, Austria by Eric Demuth, Paul Klanschek and Christian Trummer, we’re here to help people trust themselves enough to build their financial freedom — for now and the future. Our user-friendly, trade-everything platform empowers both first-time investors and seasoned experts to invest in the cryptocurrencies, crypto indices, stocks*, precious metals and commodities* they want — with any sized budget, 24/7. Our global team works across different cultures and time zones, bringing our products to more than 7 million customers, making us one of Europe’s safest and most secure platforms that powers modern investing.

Headquartered in Austria but operating across Europe, our products are built by fast-moving, talented, “roll-up-your-sleeves-and-make-it-happen” kind of people. It’s these diverse perspectives and innovative minds operating as ONE TEAM that keep Bitpanda at the cutting edge of our industry. So if you’re someone who thinks big, moves fast and wants to make an impact right from day one, then get ready to join our industry-changing team. Let’s go!

Your mission

Bitpanda serves millions of investors across Europe, and we're bringing regulated finance onchain with Vision Chain, our own OP Stack L2 blockchain. We are building the premier ecosystem for European financial institutions to issue and distribute euro-denominated tokenized assets. We're hiring a Lead Technical Product Manager to own Vision Chain as a product: the foundation that Bitpanda's onchain products run on.

You'll own how the chain works and evolves, covering topics spanning proof systems, core protocol modifications, selecting the infrastructure providers, and more. You'll design and implement compliance, identity and privacy solutions into and on the chain, to satisfy the requirements of both financial institutions and developers. You'll work on this in collaboration with both internal and external product and engineering teams, as well as Bitpanda's Compliance, Legal and Data Protection teams, as an individual contributor reporting to the Head of Web3 Product within a small, senior team.

What you’ll do 

  • Own Vision Chain at the infrastructure level, managing configuration choices (fee mechanism, block building logic, etc.), and modifications to the OP Stack, in collaboration with the OP Labs team.
  • Manage infrastructure partnerships, owning the technical relationship with providers (RPC nodes, indexing, oracles, etc.). 
  • Collaborate with Compliance and Legal to implement regulatorily-compliant onchain transaction screening, identity, and privacy solutions.
  • Run reliability, incidents and cost, and own developer documentation and partner technical onboarding until a developer relations lead joins.
  • Coordinate with the other Vision Web3 product leads to ensure the chain’s technical roadmap supports the product roadmap being built on top of it.

Who you are 

  • 6+ years of product or engineering experience, with 3+ years focused on blockchain infrastructure (e.g., L1/L2, rollup-as-a-service, node infrastructure provider, account abstraction, or an exchange protocol team).
  • Deep understanding of EVM rollup mechanics, including sequencing, fees, proofs, withdrawals, bridges, upgrade keys, and account abstraction.
  • Proven ability to translate complex business and regulatory needs into precise technical requirements and drive them to delivery through engineering teams and external partners without direct management.
  • Experience partnering with Compliance, Legal, and Data Protection teams, possessing working knowledge of the EU crypto regulatory landscape (MiCA, DORA, AML/CFT, sanctions screening).
  • Exceptional written and spoken English communication skills for internal teams, leadership, and external partners.

** This position is available in all of our Hubs.

What’s in it for you

  • Flexibility to work where you thrive – Enjoy the freedom of our Hybrid working model, combining onsite collaboration and remote work, with an additional 25 days per year to work from a city or country of your choice.
  • Reward for your impact – Receive a competitive total compensation package aligned with Bitpanda’s pay-for-impact policy, including participation in our stock option plan.
  • Support for your mental wellbeing – Access confidential coaching, counselling, and mental health resources whenever you need them through OpenUP.
  • Time to recharge – On top of your standard annual leave, prioritise your wellbeing in 2027 with 3 additional days of paid time off to rest, reset, and recharge, available once you’ve been with us for 6 months.
  • Continuous learning and growth – Grow your skills and stay ahead in your career with unlimited access to Udemy’s library of online courses at your own pace.
  • Exclusive perks and rewards – Enjoy discounts, rewards, and perks from partners worldwide across lifestyle, wellness, tech, and travel.
  • Support during life milestones – Take advantage of up to 8 additional weeks of gender-neutral new parent leave to welcome and bond with your new addition to the family.
  • Fuel and focus on-site – Pandas in Vienna, Bucharest, Barcelona, and Berlin can enjoy free onsite dining, with freshly prepared lunches and snacks to keep you fueled and focused all day long.
  • Recognition for your contributions – Celebrate milestones and achievements with recognition and rewards for your Tenure at Bitpanda.
  • Show your Bitpanda pride – Access exclusive Bitpanda-branded merchandise and gear to represent.
  • Connect and celebrate with your team – Join unforgettable company events, from our Winter Party in Vienna to gatherings worldwide, fostering fun, connection, and celebration

       .…and even more location-specific benefits designed to make life at Bitpanda even more rewarding wherever you are.

Above all, you will have the opportunity to learn and grow as part of Bitpanda’s incredible journey towards being Europe’s future #1 investment platform.

Bitpanda is committed to fostering a fair and equal environment based on trust and mutual respect. We believe that a diverse and inclusive workplace is paramount to our success and we are committed to building a team that represents a wide variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills.

About Ramp

Ramp is building the smart infrastructure for finance teams, embedded in the transaction flow of every dollar a business spends. We automate how over $275B in annualized spend flows in and out of 85,000+ companies: authorizing payments, flagging risk, categorizing spend, and closing books.

The problems are high-stakes, data-dense, and unforgiving.

We hire people with high agency and high urgency. We look for slope over intercept. We care less about where you trained and more about what you’ve built. At Ramp, everyone is a builder who owns problems end to end and makes consequential decisions that shape the outcome.

The median Ramp customer saves 7.5% and grows revenue 16% in their first year – far in excess of businesses operating without Ramp. We believe every ambitious company deserves the same.

If you want to build systems that directly shape how companies move and manage billions, Ramp is the place to do it.

About the Role

Ramp believes that AI-powered CX organizations are the future and we are racing to build the best one in the world. Our goal is for our team to work hand in hand with AI agents to drive superlative customer outcomes and the highest-velocity AI improvement engine in the business.

This role will own the strategy and ops teams that are making that transition a reality while still delivering 24/7/365 support for our 85,000+ customers every day. You will work with the Head of CX to set the goals, measure what matters, and build the systems and programs that push the team forward. You’ll manage a small and mighty team across Business Operations, CX Analytics, Workforce Management, Learning & Development, and CX AI Operations to accomplish your goals.

We believe every CX frontline specialist has a role to play driving forward the performance of our AI agents - it is not work reserved for a dedicated AI team. Each specialist needs to be trained, coached, scheduled, and rewarded for continuous work of closing AI learning loops, ensuring AI escalations get resolved, and obsessing about how our customers are actually being served.

You'll do this while running a global support operation that has to be excellent today. Once we nail the model in CX, there will be momentum to help other operations teams adopt it.

What You’ll Do

  • Set the goals and measure what matters. Work with the Head of CX and senior CX managers to set org-wide goals, decide how we measure progress, and deliver the programs and projects that enable that strategy to flourish.

  • Define how specialists and AI agents work together. Build the roles, workflows, and expectations that let specialists and AI agents serve customers as one team.

  • Change what we reward. Rebuild goals, incentives, and performance management so specialists get credit for closing AI learning loops, getting AI escalations resolved, and improving how customers are actually served, alongside traditional frontline performance.

  • Own global schedules, capacity, and quality. Plan coverage for 24/7/365, multi-tier, global support that holds a high bar for customers of all shapes and sizes.

  • Build the training model for the new work. Both new and tenured specialists need to investigate hard issues, judge agent behavior, and contribute fixes, while still developing a deep understanding Ramp’s complex financial products. L&D should make them good at all of it.

  • Turn AI progress into operating change. Know what our Investigative Copilot (specialist-facing) and AskRamp (fully agentic) can do and how well they do it. When that moves, change staffing, workflows, training, and expectations to match.

  • Build and own the voice of the CX specialist to Product and Engineering. Use CX data to show technical teams where agents succeed and where they struggle, and work with them directly on tooling, prompts, and agent behavior. They own the roadmap; you make sure CX's evidence shapes it.

  • Build a small, strong team. Develop and grow leaders across Business Operations, CX Analytics, Workforce Management, Learning & Development, and CX AI Operations, with clear ownership and shared goals.

What We’re Looking For

We want an operator who has already changed how real work gets done with AI and can show the results.

  • A record of strategic and operational execution inside an operating unit or fast growth business. That could be CX, Sales, supply chain, or another function where you owned the goals, the systems, and the outcomes.

  • A genuine AI transformation you were on the front lines of in the last 18-24 months. You changed how a team’s work gets done and kept it running in production. You can explain what improved, what failed, and what you learned.

  • Exceptional intellectual horsepower and natural curiosity, demonstrated through outstanding, standout performance across past roles in demanding environments.

  • Experience leading teams and developing reports, with sound judgment about organizational design, incentives, and performance management.

  • Analytical depth you use yourself: you can build or audit a capacity model, challenge a metric, diagnose an operating problem, or review an AI agent session to find the flaws.

  • Credibility with Product, Engineering, and Data teams, and the ability to shape their priorities without a reporting line.

  • High standards for customer quality and human accountability - you don’t compromise on the customer outcome.

Helpful Experience

  • Leadership spanning business operations, CX analytics, workforce management, learning and development, or AI operations or their equivalents in other operating teams.

  • Experience with production AI agents, evaluations, escalation workflows, and continuous improvement.

  • Taking an operating model that worked in one team and making it successful elsewhere.

How Success Will Be Measured

  • Specialists and AI agents work as one team, measured through both direct frontline performance as well as agentic velocity.

  • Every specialist is trained, coached, scheduled, and rewarded for migrating successfully into an AI native version of the role.

  • Learning loops close fast, AI escalations produce durable fixes, and new agent capabilities show up as operational gains.

  • Customer quality goes up and 24/7/365 support stays excellent while the operating model changes.

  • Other Ramp operations teams are adopting what worked in CX.

The Data Analyst – Business Intelligence role will join DRW’s Unified Platform (UP) Data Management team. UP systems are responsible for data that spans the trade lifecycle: from research, execution, through to post-trade. Our business operations generate substantial data each day. Our global footprint produces inquiries from stakeholders that require complex answers. Questions can span years of data, multiple data stores and a variety of financial domains.

This is a reporting and analysis role at the intersection of finance, trading operations, and data engineering. The work is deadline-driven; your outputs go to regulatory authorities, external auditors, and firm leadership.

What You'll Do

Answer business questions with data

  • Build and run extracts against the firm's data stores to answer requests from the front office, and other units like Tax and Legal
  • Drive improvements to market share reporting and analytics
  • Support quarterly and annual tax and regulatory inquiries across multiple global jurisdictions
  • Respond to audit, litigation, and class-action data requests, often under short turnaround

Make the numbers trustworthy

  • Validate every extract before delivery — cross-foot detail against aggregates, reconcile against source systems, and investigate discrepancies rather than explaining them away
  • Document the business rules behind each report, including who made the decision and why

Reduce the recurring load

  • Identify patterns across incoming requests
  • Partner with engineering teams to translate those patterns into durable solutions: reporting dashboards, self-service views, scheduled reports
  • Write the specification: define the business logic, the edge cases, and the validation criteria that a tool needs to get right

Required

  • 5+ years in a data analysis, business intelligence, financial reporting, or analytics engineering role
  • Advanced SQL — you are comfortable with complex multi-table joins, aggregation across different grains, CTEs, and reasoning about query performance.
  • Python for data work — pandas, database connectivity, and building repeatable scripts rather than one-off notebooks
  • Experience working with financial data: trades, positions, pricing, or reference data
  • Demonstrated care with accuracy.
  • Clear written communication — you'll be explaining methodology to accountants, lawyers, and auditors who don't read SQL
  • Bachelor's degree in a quantitative or technical field
  • Experience specifying requirements for engineering teams, or building BI tooling (Tableau, Power BI, or similar)
  • Exposure to tax, VAT/GST, or regulatory reporting
